Summary of Changes

Summary of Changes 
The December 3, 2025 release of the NICE Framework Components Version 2.1.0 includes the 
following updates: 
 
● Work Role: Comprehensive revision of Cybercrime Investigation (IN-WRL-001), including Task-
to-Knowledge/Skill alignments. 
● Competency Areas: Updated Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security (NF-COM-002). 
● Administrative Task, Knowledge, and Skill (TKS) Statement updates: Administrative 
changes detailed below. 
 
NICE Framework Components Version 2.1.0, replace v2.0.0 as the authoritative catalog of the NICE 
Framework Components, including Work Role Categories, Work Roles, Competency Areas, and TKS 
statements. The Components are available in Excel (XLSX) and JSON formats. Additional formats and 
assistance with implementation of NICE Framework Components are available on request by 
contacting NICEframework@nist.gov.  
Versioning 
A record of versions and release notes can be found on the NICE Framework Change Logs webpage in 
the NICE Framework Resource Center. This update is considered a Minor Update intended to add 
functionality, fix bugs, and make other changes that have minimal impact, if any, on backwards 
compatibility. 
 
More details regarding update types, frequency, and versioning identifiers can be found in the NICE 
Framework Resource Center. 
V 2.1.0 Update Details 
Work Roles 
Version 2.1.0 of the NICE Framework Components includes a comprehensive update to the 
Cybercrime Investigation Work Role (IN-WRL-001). This Work Role was reviewed and revised with the 
support of colleagues from the Federal Bureau of Investigation, who also led the revision of the Digital 
Evidence Analysis Work Role (IN-WRL-002), included in the release of v2.0.0. 
 
The revisions, including changes made based on feedback received the public comment period, 
included the following changes to the Work Role’s TKS statements: 
 
• Nine added statements, including seven statements newly drafted for the Work Role. 
• Eleven modified statements, whose contents were changed to more accurately reflect Work 
Role responsibilities and associated knowledge and skill needs. These modifications are 
applied across the NICE Framework and are reflected in each Work Role or Competency Area 
where the TKS statements appear.

• Nine removed statements, which were found to be out of scope for the Work Role or 
duplicative of other statements. Unless affected by administrative changes discussed below, 
these TKS statements remain part of the NICE Framework Components and are only removed 
from the Work Role. 
 
The revision also includes alignments of Tasks to Knowledge and Skill statements for the IN-WRL-001 
Work Role. Aligning these statements in a Work Role provides greater clarity on the specific knowledge 
or skills required by individuals in performance of each Task. 
Competency Areas 
Competency Areas were added to the NICE Framework Components with the March 2024 v1.0.0 
release. At that time, only titles, identifiers, and descriptions were included. Since that time, the NICE 
Program Office has been working to develop these areas to include relevant Knowledge and Skill 
statements. This release includes an update to the description of the AI Security Competency Area and 
a newly published list of Knowledge and Skill statements. 
 
• Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security (NF-COM-002): This Competency Area describes a 
learner’s capability to understand Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and to use them in a 
secure manner that maximizes AI’s benefits while minimizing potential negative risks. 
 
The Competency Area includes 70 Knowledge statements (31 of which are newly drafted) and 20 Skill 
statements (seven of which are newly drafted).

Contact Us 
The NICE Program Office welcomes suggestions for improving the usability of the NICE Framework 
and extends gratitude to NICE Framework users who notify us of potential issues. Suggestions for 
future upgrades and administrative changes may be sent to NICEframework@nist.gov at any time. We 
additionally encourage users to join the NICE Framework Users Group to share updates and connect 
with other Framework users.
